says: The ship stage rules still say red checks are run again once per head before the builder is called, which 0036 replaced: a red check is not rerun unless a fix for its cause is in flight.
proof: docs/direction/ship-stage-rules.md:16 reads 'Red checks are run again once per head before the builder is called'; .decisions/0036-a-flaky-test-is-fixed.md:12 reads 'nobody reruns it' and its diagram allows one rerun only when a fix is in flight.
cost: A ship step or merge queue built from the note reruns every red check once, which is the rerun-until-green habit 0036 forbids.
